british airways.notes: Self-service kiosks at T5. Bag drop closes 45 minutes before short-haul, 60 minutes before long-haul departures.

lufthansa.notes: Online check-in opens 23 hours before. Self-service kiosks at T2.

emirates.notes: Online check-in opens 48 hours before. Bag drop at T3 closes 60 minutes before. Long lines for First Class are common; arrive early.

delta.notes: Joint check-in with Virgin Atlantic at T3. Many kiosks; bag drop closes 60 minutes before transatlantic.

american airlines.notes: Check-in at T3, premium cabins use Flagship Check-In. Bag drop closes 60 minutes before transatlantic.

united.notes: Check-in at T2. Bag drop closes 60 minutes before departure for transatlantic flights.

virgin atlantic.notes: Check-in at T3. Upper Class has dedicated wing. Bag drop closes 60 minutes before.

klm.notes: Online check-in opens 30 hours before. T4 check-in. Bag drop closes 40 minutes before short-haul.

air france.notes: Online check-in opens 30 hours before. T4 check-in. Bag drop closes 40 minutes before short-haul.

qantas.notes: Check-in at T3. Bag drop closes 60 minutes before international flights.

singapore airlines.notes: Online check-in opens 48 hours before. T2 check-in. Bag drop closes 60 minutes before.

qatar.notes: Online check-in opens 48 hours before. T3 check-in. Bag drop closes 60 minutes before.

general_tips: Online check-in is fastest. Most airlines open it 24-48 hours before departure.
If you only have hand luggage, you can usually go straight to security after online check-in.
If you need to drop a bag, allow at least 90 minutes for short-haul and 2 hours for long-haul.
Self-service kiosks are available in every Heathrow terminal — use them to print your boarding pass and bag tags.
Premium cabins and elite frequent flyers usually have dedicated check-in desks with shorter queues.
